integrity: The analytical proof and an independently coded exact rational zonal-moment checker are included. Finite checks do not prove all-dimensional statements. Same-model scientific review only; independent validation not performed.
limitations: Real centered harmonics of degrees one and two; normalized surface measure; classical ball-Poisson multipliers; input L2 and output L4. No conclusion about higher harmonic bands, complex coefficients, unrestricted hypercontractivity, or the fractional Laplace semigroup. Possible unindexed equivalent prior literature remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp two-band spherical Poisson norms and a dimension-dependent contraction threshold
